<style id="asll-tab-panels-css">
  #panel-shop, #panel-cart, #panel-checkout { display: none; }
  body.view-shop #panel-home,
  body.view-cart #panel-home,
  body.view-checkout #panel-home { display: none !important; }
  body.view-shop #panel-shop { display: block !important; }
  body.view-cart #panel-cart { display: block !important; }
  body.view-checkout #panel-checkout { display: block !important; }
  body.view-shop #panel-cart,
  body.view-shop #panel-checkout,
  body.view-cart #panel-shop,
  body.view-cart #panel-checkout,
  body.view-checkout #panel-shop,
  body.view-checkout #panel-cart { display: none !important; }
  #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed,
  #panel-cart .asl-shop-embed,
  #panel-checkout .asl-shop-embed {
    width: min(1100px, calc(100% - 2rem));
    margin: 1.5rem auto 3rem;
  }
  #panel-cart iframe,
  #panel-checkout iframe {
    width: 100%;
    height: 400px;
    min-height: 200px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 18px;
    background: transparent;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: block;
  }
  #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed {
    --asl-bg: #0b0f17;
    --asl-card: #161e2e;
    --asl-text: #ffffff;
    --asl-muted: #c4cde0;
    --asl-orange: #f59e0b;
    --asl-border: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.28);
    font-family: Tahoma, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif;
    color: var(--asl-text);
    line-height: 1.7;
  }
  #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed .hero { margin-bottom: 2rem; text-align: center; }
  #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed .hero h1 {
    margin: 0 0 .6rem;
    font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.3rem);
    color: var(--asl-orange);
  }
  #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed .hero p { margin: 0 auto; color: var(--asl-muted); max-width: 48rem; }
  #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed .asl-shop-actions { display: flex; justify-content: center; margin: 0 0 1.25rem; }
  #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed .grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
  #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed .card {
    background: var(--asl-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--asl-border);
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 1.25rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: .85rem;
    color: #fff;
  }
  #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed .card h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #fff !important; }
  #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed .badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    width: fit-content;
    padding: .28rem .7rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.14);
    color: var(--asl-orange);
    font-size: .85rem;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed .price,
  #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed .price * {
    font-size: 1.55rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #ffffff !important;
  }
  #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed .desc { color: var(--asl-muted); margin: 0; flex: 1; }
  #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed .btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 42px;
    padding: .55rem 1rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed .btn-primary {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b, #fb923c);
    color: #111 !important;
    border: 0;
    width: 100%;
  }
  #panel-shop .asl-shop-embed .btn-ghost {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--asl-text);
    border: 1px solid var(--asl-border);
  }
